sample_unit: patients (536 development, 184 temporal validation, 626 external validation)

links.outcome: Baseline model AUROC across internal, temporal, and external (VitalDB) sites
links.effect: Baseline AUROC 0.714 internally, 0.719 temporally, 0.623 externally; external calibration slopes 0.570 and 0.534 versus about 1.11 temporally.
links.quote: Baseline-model AUROCs were 0.714 (95% confidence interval [CI], 0.667-0.756) internally, 0.719 (0.640-0.788) temporally, and 0.623 (0.579-0.666) externally.

links.outcome: Discrimination and calibration of locally developed model when applied to a different cohort
links.effect: Similar discrimination locally (temporal AUROC 0.719) but external AUROC 0.623 and calibration slope about 0.55; limited transportability without updating.
links.quote: The baseline model retained similar discrimination locally but had limited unchanged external transportability.

unlisted_practices: Testing whether adding intraoperative blood pressure features improves prediction of prolonged length of stay
Temporal validation of a prediction model on later patients from the same center

screen.reason: Empirical study testing external transportability and performance decay across different hospital datasets to evaluate implementation readiness.
